name: Paddock Violet
intendedUse: data-dense motorsport chrome; the f1-racetracks app identity
description: Near-black violet ground on oklch hue 268, with the F1 mark red as the action accent and a saturated violet as the secondary. This is NOT a new look: it is the palette f1-racetracks has rendered since v6, lifted out of three hand-baked :root blocks and one injected CSS template string and given a name. Built 2026-08-01 to answer Q8 — the app needed a neutral colour entity of its own because it is not a constructor and no team owns purple.
canonical: shared/themes/colors.tsv row `paddock` — HEX IS CANONICAL and resolve.js reads ONLY the TSV. This file is a PROJECTION for the FileMaker consumer and the preview lab. If the two disagree, the TSV wins and this file gets corrected.
provenance: bg/surface-1..3/border/text/text-soft/text-faint and the accent red are VERBATIM from f1-racetracks/source/chrome-tokens.css section 1 (--bg, --s1, --s2, --s3, --line, --txt, --txt-mid, --txt-dim, --red), which is itself the two-of-three reading that resolved the --s3 hue drift and the --txt-dim chroma drift in J17. The TSV hex was machine-converted from these oklch values, not hand-typed.
